property_summary: For every input, the correct contract calls the external counterparty with the original `from` address as the first address argument of the transferFrom call (so when that callee only succeeds if its first address equals a specific expected address, C always succeeds), whereas the mutant swaps the two addresses and thus can cause the external call to fail for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the required selector to call transferFrom(address,address,uint256) -> transferFrom(address,address,uint256) with different argument order by swapping _tos[i] and from in the abi.encodeWithSelector call, which changes which addresses are passed to the external call and thus can alter observable effects.
